content.title: STACK THESE HABITS ONTO THINGS YOU ALREADY {{DO}}
facts: While your **coffee** brews, drink a full glass of **water** first — you'll rehydrate before caffeine kicks in and curb the jittery crash.
Right after brushing your teeth, do **10 squats** — it takes 20 seconds and adds up to better circulation and stronger legs over weeks.
Every time you check your phone, roll your **shoulders** back 5 times — it counters the forward slouch and eases tension headaches.
Before your first bite at lunch, eat a handful of **raw veggies** — the **fiber** slows digestion and helps prevent an afternoon energy dip.
While waiting for the shower to warm up, do **deep breathing** for 30 seconds — it lowers cortisol and eases you into the day calmer.
Right when you plug in your phone to charge at night, put your **book** on the pillow instead of the phone — it nudges you toward better sleep and less screen-driven insomnia.
